Subject: Re: Draft: BlueHorizon Health implementation story — factual passback & quote approval

Marissa —

Thanks for the draft. A few quick corrections/requests after internal review:

1) The deployment size is slightly overstated — we ran inference on 8 GPUs, not 12. Please update section 2.
2) The latency figure of "~40ms" should be clarified as measured at p95 for 512-token requests; we prefer calling out p95 latency rather than an average.
3) Please remove the sentence that references our proprietary "clinical-match" score — we cannot publish that metric.
4) Quote: the current line is fine but could read better if it references the implementation team: "The Redwoods team enabled our clinical ops group to cut turnaround time by 45% without sacrificing accuracy." — can you adjust to this wording?

I've attached a spreadsheet with the corrected numbers (BH_data_corrections_20261102.xlsx). We can sign off once the proprietary metric is removed and the quote updated.

Matthew Khan
VP, Engineering
BlueHorizon Health
matthew.khan@bluehorizonhealth.com
